model.title: UNLOCK AUKUS Act
model.meta: Foreign Relations Committee · Sen. Pete Ricketts (R-NE)

summary.text: The bill would modify restrictions on defense exports and transfers between the United States and its allies Australia and the United Kingdom under the AUKUS partnership agreement, allowing for greater flexibility in sharing military equipment and technology among these three countries.
